2. Duties and Responsibilities.
To fulfill its mandate under
this Executive Order, the DILG shall have, among others, the following duties
and responsibilities:
1.
To call upon all national and local agencies for technical, policy,
documentary, information and resource assistance and support, in the
conduct of its strategic review;

discussions

Consultants.
The DILG may engage the services of

agencies and bodies as resource persons.
The budget needed to carry out the provisions of
this Executive Order shall be taken from available funds of the DILG.
sources of funds such as grantS, donations and other forms of technical and
resources assistance from donor agencies, projects and other public or private
entities may be tapped and facilitated by the DILG subject to regular auditing

5.
All orders, rules, regulations and
issuances or parts thereof which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately.
